name: Password Sign-In Passkey Required
summary: A user enters through Welcome, chooses email authentication, submits valid password credentials for an identity that requires passkey proof, and is handed off to the existing Passkey Sign In flow before an authenticated application session can be established.
finalOutcome: The password proof is accepted, no authenticated application session is issued yet, and the user is placed on the canonical passkey continuation surface; the existing Passkey Sign In category owns the remaining ceremony.

sourceReferences.note: Canonical Passkey Sign In entry surface already exists and is implemented on both stable clients.
Passkey-required password authentication is modeled as a distinct Password Sign-In outcome because its next action differs from TOTP while reusing the existing Passkey Sign In category after handoff.
Current password RequiresTwoFactor handling only returns provider=totp; provider=passkey selection remains an implementation gap and is not claimed complete by this behavior.
